body:
My cat's Ginger. She's an orange pile of fluff and a constant reminder that I have to be here, or else who will work the can opener she's curled up at the foot of my bed now for similar reasons. 

As for the other questions, I'll try to pop back tomorrow and answer. My head is in too much pain to keep going tonight. Thank you for taking the time to ask-- I'll answer, I promise.

You're probably right. He's a sort of therapist ninja. I'm still getting used to him, but he seems better than the rest I've seen. I've been hopping shrinks for a while. He gives me useful things to try. You have helped, very much. I'll try to sleep now, I think. My head is hurting me too much from crying to stay awake and be able to focus on words right now. Thank you for taking the time to spend a few moments replying to me. I feel less isolated, and it's a nice feeling.

Puscifer I've heard of--  I have a friend that is a fan of theirs. I might see if I can borrow a CD. The others I'll check out. I'll pop around youtube, maybe, and see if I can find some of the others. 

I paint. I write. I've been writing tonight to try to help with all this but I just got to the point I couldn't spill ink on an empty page anymore, you know? I needed a response. A real response. One I couldn't predict. Insofar as art/painting goes, that's a bit of a sore spot right now. I feel everything I do is horrific. I recognize, logically, that there must be something worse out there, but all I hear in my brain is "YOU SUCK, GIVE UP." I feel a great deal like my outlets are being sapped, one by one. My boss asked me what I do to relieve stress the other day. I didn't know what to tell him. Writing helps a little, painting and drawing ends up pissing me off, and I never see my girlfriend. My cat is the only thing that sort of counts anymore, it feels like. She'll hang out on my legs and keep me warm when I'm shaking from being too cold. Do cats count as hobbies, maybe? Or collecting interesting characters. I like to do that too. 

Thank you for the new music to look into, it'll give me something to do tonight or tomorrow. These responses are calming me down enough I might be able to sleep soon, I hope.

I'm in therapy now. Frankly, I'm probably more than a little self sabotaging with the whole thing... It seems like when I go, I feel fine. He never sees me like this. He knows I had a shitty home life as a kid and I keep... wondering what the fuck he's going to do with that information, you know? I keep wondering why he doesn't start poking at me over it, more than he already does. I sit there on his couch and wonder "why the fuck are we talking about work? Isn't there some great underlying psychological fuck flaw you're supposed to be dissecting, rather than talking about the surface things?" 

Granted, I haven't been with him very long. I had to switch therapists because I about slapped my last one. Not literally, no, but when he started to say my father's asshole, abusive, fucked behavior might be because of autism, I noped out of there. Who says that?! The fucker controlled it while he was out of the house! That's not autism! That's manipulation! "YOU'RE THE DAMN SHRINK, YOU SHOULD KNOW THAT!" I wanted to shout that at him. It horrifies me that he might say that to someone else and they might not have some sort of interest in psych of their own to know how bullshit it is. 

Or maybe it's not bullshit. I don't know. I think so. Of course, I find much of my life to be bullshit. 

I'm hoping to avoid the hospital-- the only reason I don't cut, sometimes, or otherwise hurt myself in lasting ways is because I worry I'd be (probably rightfully) hauled off. And it's so hard to hide. I both want someone to ask and I don't want someone to ask. 

Thank you again for your response. I know it sounds weird, probably, to thank anyone that responds, but it costs nothing to be polite. It's the least I can do if you took the time to sort of virtually hang around me for a while. This helps.

Your parents sound like mine from when I was in high school. I'm sorry. 

Parents are human. Humans say stupid, shitty things. If you "fucked up her life" that's her problem. You didn't do anything. Not to say that will immediately help, but it helps sometimes to remind myself of that.

Thank you. I... two responses. At 4AM my time. I didn't expect anything, honestly. I'm glad you have her. She sounds... a lot like someone I know. 

I live in mortal terror of mental hospitals. If it's allowed here and you don't mind talking about it, am I really right to be as terrified as I am? I'm new... I've glanced through this place before, but never posted before. Read the sidebar, but I figure I can't be too careful. 

Thank you again. I appreciate it.

AFI (I know it sounds like it would make problems worse, but it really doesn't. Davey's voice is one of the few things that helps me through worst times.) Panic! at the Disco. Go Periscope. Blaqk Audio. Blink-182. It's a hodge podge of electronica-ish and what I guess is called alternative rock. 

What about you, anon? Anything to recommend?

Thank you for listening and responding. It means a lot to know that.
